results.content: | 2152-RA | A comprehensive Psychometric Validation of EQ Instruments for Early Childhood Health-Related Quality of Life and Caregiver Spillover, including EQ-TIPS, EQ-5D-Y-5L, EQ-5D-5L with Sleep and Fatigue Bolt-ons, and the EQ-HWB-S | This study aims to address critical gaps in the measurement of health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in children under the age of five by conducting a comprehensive psychometric validation of the EQ-TIPS instrument, including both 3-level and 5-level versions. | 2167-RA | Comparing the psychometric performance of five energy- and sleep-related EQ-5D-5L bolt-ons in a multinational, longitudinal general population setting and their association with validated fatigue scales | **Background:**  Generic preference-based instruments like the EQ-5D-5L are widely used to assess health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in both patient and general populations. The analysis included assessment of known-groups validity, by comparing the proportion of dimension responses, the Level Sum Score (LSS) for EQ-TIPS and EQ-HWB-S, the index score for Y-3L and EQ-5D-5L, and EQ-VAS across children with different health status using effect sizes.
